name: slipstream
description: Session economics for Claude Code — burn ledger, window-aware queue, compaction anchor, rule guard.

warn_threshold_pct.title: Burn warning threshold (%)
warn_threshold_pct.description: Emit an in-session warning when estimated window burn crosses this percentage.

critical_threshold_pct.title: Critical burn threshold (%)
critical_threshold_pct.description: Emit a critical warning at this percentage.

window_tokens.title: Usage window size (tokens)
window_tokens.description: Your rolling usage window token budget. Slipstream uses this to estimate % burn.

pacing_threshold_pct.title: Pacing governor threshold (%)
pacing_threshold_pct.description: Queue dispatcher starts inserting delays when burn crosses this percentage.

pacing_max_delay.title: Pacing maximum delay (seconds)
pacing_max_delay.description: Maximum delay inserted between dispatched jobs at 100% burn.

haiku_model.title: Haiku model ID
haiku_model.description: Claude model used for queue pre-flight and decision briefs. Change only if you need to pin a specific dated version.
